housing_details.info:
Reg #2849 - Fixed
Workers are responsible for maintaining housing in a neat, clean manner.  Other than normal wear and tear, the reasonable repair cost of damage may be billed to workers found responsible for damage to housing or furnishings.  This arrangement creates no tenancy in employer-provided housing.  The employer retains possession and control of the housing premises at all times.  Workers provided housing shall vacate the housing promptly upon termination of employment.
